summary: This topic details how to map defined subjects to specific classes, streams, and sections. It covers the distinction between general subjects (for all students) and optional/additional subjects (for selected students) and how to configure them.
steps: Select the 'Class' (multiple classes can be selected if subjects are common).
Optionally, select the 'Stream' and 'Sections' (defaults to all sections).
Click 'Add Subject' to define subjects for this mapping.
Select the 'Subject' from the dropdown list.
Verify the 'Assessment Model' (it will be pre-filled from subject definition).
Select the 'Subject Type' (General, Optional, Additional, Vocational).
Click 'Add' to include the subject in the mapping.
Repeat for all subjects relevant to the selected class(es).
business_rules: General subjects are common and applied to all students in the mapped class.
Optional, Additional, or Vocational subjects are not common for all students and must be assigned individually to specific students later.
important_notes: The 'Display Name' provided during mapping will be used for marks entry and visible to students and teachers.
questions: How do I assign subjects to a specific class?
